title: Brain Builder workspace model
description: A company's whole configuration as one record: the workspace model the builder's editors write and every output is compiled from. Shaped after the configuration package (brain-config.yaml, ontology/*.yaml, mappings/*.yaml, profiles/*.yaml) so import and export are lossless. Keys the model does not name are kept beside each item in `extra` (from the terms or relations file) and `description_extra` (from the descriptions file).

company.description: brain-config.yaml `company`: key, name and anything else the package says about the company.

package.description: How the package is laid out: brain-config.yaml without `company`, kept whole (paths, generated, reports, runner). Export writes the files where it says.

terms_header.description: Top-level keys of the terms file other than node_types and common_attributes.

relations_header.description: Top-level keys of the relations file other than relations.

descriptions_rest.description: What the descriptions file says about things the model does not hold.

common_attributes.description: Attributes every type carries; null when the package has none.

documents.description: Other ontology parts (node descriptions), kept as documents.

processes.description: The processes document (rules, report rules, processes).

edit_sources.description: Where each type, relation and fact is edited.

sources.description: Sync components and what they read (step B7). Not part of a configuration package yet.

level.description: core: the Brain's own ontology, read-only. pack: an industry pack. company: the company's own.

described.description: What every term carries for rule 8: labels, a description, an example and what not to confuse it with.

level_label.description: The level as the package names it, written back on export.

retired.description: Retired in the builder: kept, marked, until publishing decides.

enum_labels.description: Labels and descriptions per enum value.

target.description: The type an entity_ref attribute points to.

note.description: The technical note the terms file gives the attribute.

sentence.description: How the relation reads between two nodes.
